title: Governance Invariant Evaluation Result
description: Canonical, attributable, integrity-protected result of evaluating one DS-008 Governance Invariant Definition for a specific Governed Action Proposal, Proposal Identity, Tenant, governance domain, target, evaluation horizon, Governance Version, and qualified governance-input set. DS-012 records applicability, deterministic assertion evaluation, preserved, violated, indeterminate, or not-applicable outcomes, and explicitly identifies any resulting Structural Refusal, governed escalation, lifecycle effect, and Governance Evidence without itself authorizing execution or establishing authority at commitment.
$comment: DS-012 is proposal-specific and invariant-specific. JSON Schema enforces structural and outcome-specific consistency; implementations must additionally verify semantic equality among proposal, Tenant, governance domain, target, policy, configuration, Governance Version, Canonical State, evidence, authority, lifecycle, invariant, effect, and digest bindings.
x-agcp-schema-role: Governance Decision Function — Invariant Evaluation Result

invariant_evaluation_outcome.description: Canonical result of evaluating the applicable Governance Invariant for the bound proposal and evaluation horizon.

namespaced_extensions.description: Explicitly namespaced non-normative extensions. Extensions cannot alter canonical DS-012 meaning, outcome, refusal, escalation, lifecycle, or evidence semantics.

invariant_evaluation_ref.description: Stable attributable and integrity-bound reference to a DS-012 Governance Invariant Evaluation Result.

evaluated_assertion.description: Result for one deterministically evaluated assertion or protected property of the bound invariant.

structural_refusal_effect.description: Explicit identification of whether the invariant result produces Structural Refusal and the canonical DS-028 refusal evidence.

escalation_effect.description: Explicit identification of any governed escalation resulting from invariant evaluation. Approval artifacts are evidence and do not themselves establish authority at commitment.

lifecycle_effect.description: Explicit authoritative-lifecycle effect resulting from invariant evaluation. DS-012 identifies the effect; DS-038 remains the authoritative lifecycle record.
